**Methodology Section (Img 1 & 2):**
The section correctly renders the four large step cards: **الاستكشاف**, **التصميم**, **البناء**, and **الإطلاق والعمـل**. Each card includes the required icon chip, title, duration pill, and a large ghost number (01–04) on the left. The **thin vertical progress line with blue dots** is accurately positioned on the **right side** of the container, consistent with RTL layout. There are no overlaps; spacing between cards is uniform.

**Testimonials Section (Img 3):**
This section displays **4 dark cards** on a grid background. Each card features:
*   A blue quote icon at the top.
*   **5 yellow stars** for rating.
*   Arabic testimonial text.
*   An avatar circle containing an initial letter (**ع, ي, خ, ج**) in blue.
*   Name and company details below.

All specified elements are present and clearly visible without any missing components or layout issues.
